checks.name: attack:header_only
checks.failure: gate failed: gene_counts.tsv lists every gene exactly once

oracle_components.name: gene_counts
oracle_components.note: min over samples of sum(min(obs,true))/max(sum obs,sum true); full credit >= 0.90

oracle_components.name: sample_sex
oracle_components.note: inferred_sex equals the sex of the library inside the FASTQ for every sample (credited only together with gene_counts)

oracle_components.name: sample_labels
oracle_components.note: condition_used is the true condition of every library; mixed-up samples may instead be excluded (credited only together with gene_counts)

oracle_components.name: de_false_discoveries
oracle_components.note: false-discovery proportion among significant genes vs planted truth; full credit <= 0.12, none >= 0.30; scaled down when fewer than half of the planted genes are found

oracle_components.name: de_sensitivity
oracle_components.note: fraction of planted DE genes called significant with the right sign; full credit >= 0.85, none <= 0.50; scaled down when the false-discovery proportion exceeds 0.30

oracle_components.name: de_log2fc
oracle_components.note: median |log2fc - planted log2FC| over planted DE genes; full credit <= 0.33, none >= 0.55
